name: watch
description: Let Claude watch a video with /watch, and edit a local one with /edit. /watch downloads with yt-dlp, extracts auto-scaled frames with ffmpeg, pulls captions or falls back to Whisper, and hands frames + transcript to Claude. /edit trims, merges, compresses, speeds up/down, watermarks, burns in subtitles, converts to GIF, and more, purely via local ffmpeg — no API keys.

interface.shortDescription: Give Claude a video input and a video editor — paste a URL or path and ask about it, or ask it to trim/edit a local file.
interface.longDescription: watch adds two skills. /watch lets the agent watch any video: it downloads with yt-dlp, extracts auto-scaled frames with ffmpeg, pulls a timestamped transcript from native captions (or the Whisper API as a fallback), and hands frames + transcript to the model so it can answer questions grounded in what's actually on screen and in the audio. /edit lets the agent edit a local video file — trim, merge, compress, change speed, adjust volume, mute, watermark, burn in or embed subtitles, convert to GIF, resize, crop, rotate, extract audio, or grab a thumbnail — purely via local ffmpeg, with no cloud calls or API keys.
defaultPrompt: /watch https://youtu.be/dQw4w9WgXcQ what happens at the 30 second mark?
/edit clip.mp4 trim the first 10 seconds off
